_README: Ground-truth labels for evaluation — INDEPENDENT of the tool's own output. Each key is a HAR filename in the --har-dir. 'deser_sinks' lists the vectors that ARE genuine insecure-deserialization sinks (determined from the serialization format's magic bytes, per spec: O:/a: = PHP, 0xACED = Java, 0x0408 = Ruby Marshal). Everything the tool flags that is NOT in deser_sinks counts as a false positive. A negative HAR (a normal, non-deser capture) has deser_sinks: [] — every flag on it is a false positive. Match is on (location, name); URL is ignored so the same sink on several pages is one logical positive.
